answer: With a Documentation page accepted by the project lead backed by a time-locked stake, the network asks for proof of craft before proof of personhood: the documentation page is reviewed line by line, the time-locked stake is released only when the work is accepted, and a rejected submission costs the applicant time and money, so fakes must pass the same review bar as honest contributors. One thread proves nothing on its own; the proof is in the whole pattern of accepted work. Whether the proof comes from a inlet or a dawn, the verification step is identical and public.
